```{r}
# Checking MSE
set.seed(1)
train_index <- sample(nrow(merged), 0.8 * nrow(merged))
train <- merged[train_index, ]
test  <- merged[-train_index, ]

model_lm_1 <- lm(duration ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data  = train)
model_rf_1 <- randomForest::randomForest(
  duration ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data = train
)
model_gbm_1 <- gbm::gbm(
  duration ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data = train,
  distribution = "gaussian",
  n.trees = 3000, 
  interaction.depth = 4,
  shrinkage = 0.01,
  cv.folds = 5
)

rmse <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
}

rmse_lm  <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_lm_1,  test))
rmse_rf  <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_rf_1,  test))
rmse_gbm <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_gbm_1, test, n.trees = 3000))

cbind(
  Model = c("LM", "Random Forest", "GBM"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse_lm, rmse_rf, rmse_gbm)
)
```
```{r}
# Checking both RMSE and MAE for three full models

rmse <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
}

# MAE function
mae <- function(actual, predicted) {
  mean(abs(actual - predicted))
}

# RMSE
rmse_lm  <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_lm_1,  test))
rmse_rf  <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_rf_1,  test))
rmse_gbm <- rmse(test$duration, predict(model_gbm_1, test, n.trees = 3000))

# MAE
mae_lm  <- mae(test$duration, predict(model_lm_1,  test))
mae_rf  <- mae(test$duration, predict(model_rf_1,  test))
mae_gbm <- mae(test$duration, predict(model_gbm_1, test, n.trees = 3000))

# Results
cbind(
  Model = c("LM", "Random Forest", "GBM"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse_lm, rmse_rf, rmse_gbm),
  MAE   = c(mae_lm, mae_rf, mae_gbm)
)

```

```{r}
# Checking MSE
# duration for log
set.seed(1)
train_index <- sample(nrow(merged), 0.8 * nrow(merged))
train <- merged[train_index, ]
test  <- merged[-train_index, ]



model_lm_log <- lm(log(duration) ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data  = train)
model_rf_log <- randomForest::randomForest(
  log(duration) ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data  = train
)
model_gbm_log <- gbm::gbm(
  log(duration) ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type, data  = train,
  distribution = "gaussian",
  n.trees = 3000, 
  interaction.depth = 4,
  shrinkage = 0.01,
  cv.folds = 5
)


# 1) Get predictions on the log scale
pred_lm_log  <- predict(model_lm_log,  newdata = test)
pred_rf_log  <- predict(model_rf_log,  newdata = test)
pred_gbm_log <- predict(model_gbm_log, newdata = test, n.trees = 3000)

# 2) Back-transform to the original duration scale
pred_lm  <- exp(pred_lm_log)
pred_rf  <- exp(pred_rf_log)
pred_gbm <- exp(pred_gbm_log)

# 3) Compute RMSE in original units (seconds)
rmse_lm  <- rmse(test$duration, pred_lm)
rmse_rf  <- rmse(test$duration, pred_rf)
rmse_gbm <- rmse(test$duration, pred_gbm)

mae <- function(actual, predicted) {
  mean(abs(actual - predicted))
}

mae_lm  <- mae(test$duration, pred_lm)
mae_rf  <- mae(test$duration, pred_rf)
mae_gbm <- mae(test$duration, pred_gbm)


cbind(
  Model = c("LM", "Random Forest", "GBM"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse_lm, rmse_rf, rmse_gbm),
  MAE   = c(mae_lm, mae_rf, mae_gbm)
)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(gbm)

# 1. Prepare data

# Keep only valid durations and needed variables
data_model <- merged |>
  filter(duration > 0) |>
  mutate(log_duration = log(duration)) |>
  select(log_duration, temp_c, wind_speed, precip_mm,
         weather_code, member_casual, rideable_type) |>
  na.omit()

# Base model formula (same for LM, RF, GBM)
form_base <- log_duration ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
  weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type

# 2. Set up k-fold CV

set.seed(123)
k <- 5
n <- nrow(data_model)
fold_id <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))

mae_lm  <- numeric(k)
mae_rf  <- numeric(k)
mae_gbm <- numeric(k)

mae_fun <- function(actual, pred) mean(abs(actual - pred))

# 3. Run CV loop

for (i in 1:k) {
  cat("Fold", i, "...\n")
  
  train <- data_model[fold_id != i, ]
  test  <- data_model[fold_id == i, ]
  
  ## (1) Linear model
  fit_lm <- lm(form_base, data = train)
  pred_lm <- predict(fit_lm, newdata = test)
  mae_lm[i] <- mae_fun(test$log_duration, pred_lm)
  
  ## (2) Random forest
  fit_rf <- randomForest(
    form_base,
    data = train,
    ntree = 300
  )
  pred_rf <- predict(fit_rf, newdata = test)
  mae_rf[i] <- mae_fun(test$log_duration, pred_rf)
  
  ## (3) GBM
  fit_gbm <- gbm(
    form_base,
    data = train,
    distribution = "gaussian",
    n.trees = 1000,
    interaction.depth = 3,
    shrinkage = 0.01,
    n.minobsinnode = 20,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  pred_gbm <- predict(fit_gbm, newdata = test, n.trees = 1000)
  mae_gbm[i] <- mae_fun(test$log_duration, pred_gbm)
}

# 4. Summarize CV-MAE

cv_mae_results <- data.frame(
  Model   = c("Linear regression", "Random forest", "GBM"),
  Mean_MAE = c(mean(mae_lm), mean(mae_rf), mean(mae_gbm)),
  SD_MAE   = c(sd(mae_lm),   sd(mae_rf),   sd(mae_gbm))
)

cv_mae_results

```


### Model selection part for lm

```{r}
# Linear regression for adding interaction terms and polynomial terms.

# log(duration) ~ temp_c + I(temp_c^2) + wind_speed + I(wind_speed^2) + precip_mm + member_casual + rideable_type + weather_code + temp_c:precip_mm + member_casual:weather_code

# lm_reduced <- lm(log(duration) ~ member_casual + rideable_type + precip_mm + weather_code + member_casual:weather_code + temp_c:precip_mm, data = merged)

```



```{r}
library(lubridate)
merged$day_type <- ifelse(wday(merged$started_at) %in% c(1, 7),
                          "weekend", "weekday")
merged$day_type <- factor(merged$day_type)

# Based lm model
lm1 <- lm(log(duration) ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
            weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type + day_type,
          data = merged)

# Add one polynomials - temp² only — because temperature is smoother
lm2 <- lm(log(duration) ~ temp_c + I(temp_c^2) +
            wind_speed + precip_mm +
            weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type + day_type,
          data = merged)

# Add one interaction - member × weather_code
lm3 <- lm(log(duration) ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
            weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type +
            member_casual:weather_code + day_type,
          data = merged)

# Add Polynomials + key interaction
lm4 <- lm(log(duration) ~ temp_c + I(temp_c^2) +
            wind_speed + precip_mm +
            weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type +
            member_casual:weather_code + day_type,
          data = merged)

# Full model
lm5 <- lm(log(duration) ~ temp_c + I(temp_c^2) +
            wind_speed + I(wind_speed^2) +
            precip_mm +
            weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type +
            temp_c:precip_mm + member_casual:weather_code + day_type,
          data = merged)

```



```{r}
# Compare AIC/BIC
AIC(lm1, lm2, lm3, lm4, lm5)
BIC(lm1, lm2, lm3, lm4, lm5)

# Compare adjusted R^2
summary(lm1)$adj.r.squared
summary(lm2)$adj.r.squared
summary(lm3)$adj.r.squared
summary(lm4)$adj.r.squared
summary(lm5)$adj.r.squared

```

library(caret)

                   weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type + day_type,
                data = merged,
                method = "lm",
                trControl = ctrl,
                metric="MAE")

cv_lm3 <- train(form = log(duration) ~ temp_c + wind_speed + precip_mm +
                   weather_code + member_casual + rideable_type +
                   member_casual:weather_code + day_type,
                data = merged,
                method = "lm",
                trControl = ctrl,
                metric="MAE")

cv_lm1

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

newdata <- expand.grid(
  temp_c = mean(merged$temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
  wind_speed = mean(merged$wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
  precip_mm = mean(merged$precip_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  weather_code = unique(merged$weather_code),
  member_casual = c("casual", "member"),
  rideable_type = "electric_bike",
  day_type = c("weekday", "weekend")
)

# Predict log duration
newdata$pred_log <- predict(lm3, newdata)

# Convert to seconds
newdata$pred_duration_seconds <- exp(newdata$pred_log)

# Convert to minutes
newdata$pred_duration_min <- newdata$pred_duration_seconds / 60

# Plot
ggplot(newdata, aes(x = factor(weather_code,
             levels = c(0,1,2,3,51,53,63),
             labels = c("Clear sky","Mainly clear","Fog/Mist","Cloudy",
                        "Light drizzle","Moderate rain","Heavy rain")), 
                    y = pred_duration_min, 
                    color = member_casual, group = member_casual)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Trip Duration by Weather Condition and Membership",
    x = "Weather Code",
    y = "Predicted Duration (minutes)",
    color = "Rider Type"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

ggplot(newdata, aes(x = factor(weather_code,
             levels = c(0,1,2,3,51,53,63),
             labels = c("Clear sky","Mainly clear","Fog/Mist","Cloudy",
                        "Light drizzle","Moderate rain","Heavy rain")),
                    y = pred_duration_min,
                    color = member_casual,
                    linetype = day_type,
                    group = interaction(member_casual, day_type))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Trip Duration by Weather, Membership, and Day Type",
    x = "Weather Condition",
    y = "Predicted Duration (minutes)",
    color = "Rider Type",
    linetype = "Day Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

```
